faqs.question: What does ACT Creative Singapore do?
faqs.answer: ACT Creative coordinates event fabrication, exhibition booths, custom props, sculpture, merchandise, mobile event units, supplier sourcing, production, logistics and local delivery. Clients work with one project team while ACT Creative manages the required specialist suppliers and execution route.

faqs.question: Can ACT Creative fabricate an event activation in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Support can include technical development, materials, scenic builds, custom props, graphics, pre-assembly, freight, installation, venue submissions and site-ready handover, depending on the brief and venue requirements.

faqs.question: Does ACT Creative design and build exhibition booths?
faqs.answer: Yes. ACT Creative supports booth design review, technical detailing, production planning, fabrication, logistics, venue coordination, installation and dismantling for Singapore exhibitions and overseas exhibitors.

faqs.question: Can ACT Creative source and manufacture custom items in China?
faqs.answer: Yes. The team can identify suitable factories, compare specifications and quotations, coordinate samples and production, follow up quality control, plan packing and freight, and manage delivery into Singapore or other supported markets.

faqs.question: Can ACT Creative make large custom props or sculptures?
faqs.answer: Yes. Available production routes include scenic props, oversized objects, FRP sculpture, stainless-steel sculpture, mixed-material installations, finishing, packing, freight and local installation coordination.

faqs.question: Does ACT Creative provide food trucks or Kombi vans in Singapore?
faqs.answer: ACT Creative can check a very limited local pool of compact mobile units, discuss vintage Kombi-style vans for activations, or coordinate a purpose-built food, retail or roadshow truck through China manufacturing, shipping and Singapore delivery. The compact silver format generally has only one to two local units, so the vehicle, date, branding, transport, site conditions and permits must be confirmed before the booking is treated as available.

faqs.question: Can ACT Creative help shortlist an event venue in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Yes. The public venue finder contains 135 reviewed venue records and supports filtering and comparison. ACT Creative can also help turn the shortlist into a practical planning route; capacity, availability, pricing and venue rules require direct confirmation.

faqs.question: How should a client request a quotation?
faqs.answer: Send the project objective, event date, delivery or venue location, reference images or drawings, quantity, budget range and required services to contact@actcreative.net. ACT Creative will clarify the scope before recommending a production and delivery route.
